note: A mixed-dtype staged contraction (f32 A, f16 B). Sizing both slab fills by A's element width issues 16 B cp.async chunks at f32 spacing over f16 memory — misaligned addresses and overlapped data. Each slab, fill and descriptor must be sized by its own operand's width. The strides here are 16 B-aligned, so the fill itself is what is under test.
